[LOPQ.3.3] **Everything else is sealed.** Every representation operation —
`len`, indexing, every member of the representation type ([LGRA.9.6.2]), a `::` cast of the
representation ([LGRA.9.6]), interpolation of the raw value into a string, and
any other builtin method of the representation — applied to an opaque receiver
is a compile error (`DS_VALIDATE_OPAQUE_NO_OP`). Value ordering (`<` `<=` `>`
`>=`) is likewise sealed in v1 (ordering is deferred, [LOPQ.10.4]). The
validator consults the type's **declared** operation surface
([LOPQ.3.1]–[LOPQ.3.2]) for an opaque receiver, not the representation's
builtin method table ([LOPQ.9.4]).
